gate: a decision verb in the title, a mapped sector, and either a procurement mandate or an outlay of at least Rs 1000 cr

releases.title: CAPEX Support Scheme to Promote Critical Mineral Processing
theme_names: Critical minerals (lithium, nickel, cobalt) — mining, processing, recycling
history: No measured basket history yet. The 2026-11-04 capex scheme (Rs 2,814 cr) funds only four plants (2 lithium >=30 kt, 2 nickel >=50 kt), picked by the LOWEST subsidy bid; no company has filed that it will bid.

small_caps.name: Mishra Dhatu Nigam Ltd
small_caps.why: Own NSE filing 27-Oct-2026: MoU with Heavy Water Board and BARC for recovery of nickel and cobalt from plant reverts. (NSE filing summaries read 2026-11-04; the company has NOT said it will bid for the 2026-11-04 scheme)
